system.description: A wrestler, a martial artist, a sword-wielder, etc. Build from heroes successfully Attacked by Skeeterbots in Scene 1. (1 per DNA-sampled hero of matching archetype.)
system.tactics: Mimic the copied hero; choose two abilities from the listed options, or make one up that mimics something the hero is good at.

system.description: Choose two abilities: Imbalancing Strike: Attack, then apply a −1 penalty to the target. | Disarming Strike: +1 to Boost actions and Overcome attempts to disarm a target. | Counterstrike: When succeeding on a damage save, immediately Attack against the target that attacked you using half (rounded down) the result of the damage save, if within close combat range.
